Description: Randomly pair samples across modalities without considering class labels.
Primary_Concern: Pairs may connect semantically unrelated ASD and NON-ASD representations.

Description: Pair samples across modalities only when they share the same diagnostic class.
Primary_Concern: Requires balancing to prevent dominant classes or modalities from controlling training.

Description: Pair aggregate class centroids across modality representation spaces.
